name: XML
description: Parse XML into JSON or generate XML from JSON data.

parameters.name: input_data
parameters.label: Input Data
parameters.description: Parse XML text into { data }; element and attribute values stay as strings, repeated elements become arrays, attributes use @_ and text with attributes uses #text. Generate accepts a JSON object or array (including expressions) and returns { xml }. Limits: 1 MB input/output, 64 nested levels, 10,000 values/elements. DTDs and custom entities are not supported.

parameters.name: root_name
parameters.label: Root Element
parameters.description: Generate wraps your JSON in this root element. Top-level arrays use item elements. Use @_name for attributes and #text for text content; XML formatting and mixed-content order are not preserved.
